newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco c.bank holds no auction amid liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Morocco c.bank holds no auction amid liquid market.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) held no weekly repurchase auction because the market was too liquid and commercial banks offered lower interest rates than its own, a bank official said on Friday.

"We held no weekly auction because the market was too liquid...Commercial banks and other financial institutions prefer to borrow from one another as the interbank rate was lower than the central bank rate," the official said.
It was the second week that Bank al-Maghrib held no repurchase auction.
